Agent Customer access is only through currently assigned tickets; revoke immediately on reassignment or loss of scope; no separate grant.
Existing Tenant Admin owns within-tenant central triage; Manager remains assigned-team scoped; no new role, permission, or grant; Platform Admin has no routine ticket-business access.
Approved permanent tenant deletion after grace and independent second-admin approval overrides deactivated-user retention; retain only minimal protected audit metadata.
Customer Search contract, fields, matching, filtering, sorting, pagination, scopes, and direct-ID enforcement are resolved.
Feedback Read scopes and returned fields are resolved; no conversation history/message content access.
Email masking applies to all roles and paths; only Tenant Admin may unmask through own-tenant Customer detail with audit.
